result.description: Autonomous AI software engineer (Cognition) with a v3 REST API to manage sessions, knowledge, playbooks and secrets, plus an official hosted MCP server.
result.auth_detail: API v3 uses cog_-prefixed credentials sent as Bearer: service user API keys (recommended for automation) or personal access tokens (act as the user). Legacy apk_ keys are deprecated. No OAuth2 for third-party apps documented.
result.access_detail: Docs name no plan gate for org-scoped service users or PATs. The service user is created under Settings > Devin API. The pricing page has a Free plan and a "Devin API" row, but the cell values did not extract, so free-tier API access is unconfirmed. Enterprise endpoints (/v3/enterprise/*) need an enterprise-scoped service user, and PATs are disabled by default under an enterprise policy. Usage is billed at API pricing. Treat as likely self-serve, with moderate uncertainty on whether a paid plan is needed.
result.api_notes: v3 REST. The organization scope (/v3/organizations/*) covers sessions (create, list, status, messages), knowledge, playbooks and secrets. The enterprise scope (/v3/enterprise/*) covers orgs, consumption, audit logs and analytics. v1 and v2 are legacy.
result.blocker: Free-tier API access is unconfirmed, as the pricing table did not render. Auth is a static key or PAT only, with no OAuth for end users. Enterprise endpoints need an enterprise account.

evidence.quote: All API credentials use the `cog_` prefix format.
Personal Access Tokens (PATs) allow human users to authenticate programmatically under their own identity.
Service users are non-human accounts designed for API integrations.
Legacy API keys are deprecated. Use API v3 with service user authentication.
